easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Flicker of Fate.
description:
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Flicker of Fate, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Flicker of Fate, blinking Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.
